about: Every message Aaron typed or dictated in this session on Terra (the PC), copied verbatim from its log on 25 September 2026, re-copied at sign-off. Only his words. Taken from both places the log keeps them - the queued record of every message he sends and the plain user records, including the text beside a screenshot, which the queued record does not carry (programmer rule 26). Each message is kept once at its earliest time. Messages he sent while Claude was still working sit in time order with the rest and are not marked apart, because a queued record alone does not show that. System text, tool output, skill instructions, task notifications, cross-session messages, sub-agent hand-backs, compaction summaries and anything the studio wrote are excluded, as is the harness wrapper around a paste (the paste itself is kept whole), as are the helper agents' logs beside this one. The session was still open as this was written, so the last few messages of the day are not in it.
